QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Blue Dragon Cannon Test Operation
QuestInfo.0: The amplifier hasn't been installed yet, but the many other parts of the Blue Dragon Cannon are complete. Talk to #bEdea#k at the #bHeliseum Reclamation HQ#k.
QuestInfo.1: Edea wants to test the Blue Dragon Cannon. #bGo to the empty lot of the Reclamation HQ with the incomplete Blue Dragon Cannon#k and test it out. You can reach the empty lot through the #bportal by going up the rock to the west of the Reclamation HQ#k.
QuestInfo.2: The test of the incomplete Blue Dragon Cannon was a success.
